review_evidence: Declaration grep over 129 files: minimum count 1 (HexMinPoly/Lcm.lean); every file has at least one declaration.
HexMinPoly/Lcm.lean read completely: defines Hex.Matrix.basisOrderLcm, an lcm fold of vecMinPoly over standard basis vectors.

HexInterval/Experiment/PntFks2FamilyData00.lean read at head and tail: defines proofChunk00, proofChunkCount00, cells00 as Lean List Cell data copied from pinned PNT+ FKS2 shard 00, with distinct rational tuples.

The 13 PntFks2FamilyDataNN files each have 3 declarations and PntFks2ShardData.lean has 4 (abbrev Q, cellChunk, cells11); cells00 and cells11 are referenced from PntFks2FamilyData.lean and PntFks2Shard.lean.
Files with zero theorem/lemma lines (e.g. Experiment/Frontend.lean, Fact.lean, SinTen.lean, TargetRun.lean) still carry def/structure/instance declarations and are retained as formal interfaces.
Files such as HexReflect/Kernel.lean, HexReflect/Proof.lean and HexMinPoly/MinPoly.lean contain 4 to 9 theorem declarations each.
summary: Surveyed all 129 listed .lean files (sizes 625 to 104586 bytes) in reservoir-sources/kim-em__hex-dev. A line-start grep for theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque/elab/macro/syntax (with private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/meta modifiers) found at least one declaration in every file; no file is import-only. The smallest file (HexMinPoly/Lcm.lean) and the largest generated-looking files (PntFks2FamilyData00-13, PntFks2ShardData) were read in part: the data files are Lean definitions of certified numeric cell tables that downstream Lean definitions (PntFks2FamilyData.lean, PntFks2Shard.lean) consume; each shard holds distinct tuples, so no file is an exact duplicate of another indexed document. No file meets the FILTER-004 content bar for exclusion; all files are retained.
